[EN] One-stop Shopping at Argon Depot
[ES] Todo en un solo lugar en el depósito de argones
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Some of our finest minds work out of the {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber}.
[ES] Algunas de nuestras mejores mentes trabajan desde {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Now, let us see what we can see.
[ES] Ahora, veamos qué podemos encontrar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet {@LinkCreature:246#3003#Ashinne} at the {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber}.
[ES] Reúnete con {@LinkCreature:246#3003#Ashinne} en la {@Rgn:46016$$Mindcrown Chamber}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Consider it done."
[ES] "Consideralo hecho."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Altered Sikandari Feather
[ES] Pluma sikandari alterada
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt {@LinkCreature:46#301#argonomorph sikandaris} near the {@Rgn:46008} and collect their feathers.
[ES] Caza {@LinkCreature:46#301#argonomorph sikandaris} cerca de {@Rgn:46008} y recoge sus plumas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the feathers to {@LinkCreature:246#3003#Ashinne}.
[ES] Entrégales las plumas a {@LinkCreature:246#3003#Ashinne}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Tainted Fiend Heart
[ES] Corazón de infernal mancillado
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt the {@LinkCreature:46#303#argonomorph blood fiends} that appeared in the {@Rgn:46006} and collect their hearts.
[ES] Caza los {@LinkCreature:46#303#argonomorph blood fiends} que aparecieron en {@Rgn:46006} y recoge sus corazones.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the hearts to {@LinkCreature:246#3003#Ashinne}.
[ES] Entrégales los corazones a {@LinkCreature:246#3003#Ashinne}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm on it."
[ES] "En eso estoy."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Argonified Fey Focus
[ES] Foco fey argonizado
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hunt {@LinkCreature:46#304#argonomorph jalmaraks} in the {@Rgn:46007$$Raga Evala Depths} and collect their foci.
[ES] Caza {@LinkCreature:46#304#argonomorph jalmaraks} en la {@Rgn:46007$$Raga Evala Depths} y recoge sus focos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the foci to {@LinkCreature:246#3003#Ashinne}.
[ES] Entrégales los focos a {@LinkCreature:246#3003#Ashinne}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "My pleasure."
[ES] "Es un placer."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
